description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105), removes KO [Raise: 100%], grants [Last Stand] and [Haste], grants [Awoken Water God], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Quick Cast] to the user

description.name: Awoken Water God
description.text: Water abilities don't consume uses, Water abilities, casts Oracle's Prayer after using two Water abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Oracle's Prayer
description.text: Five single attacks (2.72/2.77/2.82/2.87/2.92 each), restores HP (10/15/25/35/45) to all allies at rank 1/2/3/4/5 of the triggering ability

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle
